 Sajid Raza Published: Oct 23, 2026, 15:46 IST Updated: Oct 23, 2026, 15:46 IST Telangana SSC Exam Fee Dates 2027 Released for March Exams The Telangana SSC Exam Fee Dates 2027 have been released for students taking the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) Public Examinations in March 2027. The Directorate of Government Examinations (DGE), Telangana has published Examination Fees Payment Schedule for Regular and Students who have failed in the exam.
 According to the said schedule, students will have the opportunity to pay the fee for the Telangana SSC Exam 2027 without late fee from 30th October to 16th November 2026. Students who fail to pay the examination fee on time will have further chances to pay the examination fee on time by paying the prescribed late fee.
 The fee schedule is valid for SSC, OSSC and Vocational Public Examinations. It is very important for students to read the important dates, examination fee information and payment instructions to ensure that they do not miss the deadline.
 Telangana SSC Exam Fee Dates 2027: Important Dates 
 Students appearing for the Telangana Class 10 Board Exams 2027 can check the important dates related to the examination fee payment below.
 Event Dates 
 Fee payment without late fee October 30 to November 16, 2026 
 Fee payment with ₹50 late fee November 18 to December 1, 2026 
 Fee payment with ₹200 late fee December 3 to December 14, 2026 
 Fee payment with ₹500 late fee December 16 to December 28, 2026 
 Students are advised to pay their Telangana SSC examination fee within the regular deadline to avoid additional charges.
 Telangana SSC Exam Fee 2027: Fee Details 
 The examination fee for Telangana SSC Public Examinations 2027 has been specified according to the number of subjects and course category.
 Category Examination Fee 
 All subjects (six subjects) ₹125 
 Up to three subjects ₹110 
 SSC Vocational students Additional ₹60 
 Vocational candidates must pay the applicable regular SSC examination fee along with the additional vocational fee.
 Eligible students should also check whether they qualify for any examination fee exemption under the applicable government rules.
 Telangana SSC Exam Fee Payment 2027: How to Pay 
 Students are requested to follow the fee payment procedure of SSC exam to their respective school Headmaster / Principal in Telangana.
 Examination fee will be paid via the school level process. The following steps should be taken by students:
 Contact the Headmaster or Principal of the respective school.
 Confirm the applicable Telangana SSC examination fee and payment deadline.
 Provide the required student details for the examination application.
 Pay the examination fee through the method instructed by the school.
 Collect or retain the fee payment acknowledgement, if provided.
 Confirm with the school that the examination application details have been submitted correctly.
 Students are not to expect that by paying the fee they have fulfilled all the examination requirements. 
 They should check with the school authorities the status and information of their application.
 Telangana SSC Exam Fee 2027: Instructions for Schools 
 The Directorate of Government Examinations has also set deadlines on which schools need to pay the examination fees collected and provide students' information.
 If late fee is not charged, the school should submit the money via Cyber Treasury from November 4 to November 17, 2026. The student data should be delivered to the District Educational Officer (DEO) by 21/11/2026.
 The deadlines for other fee categories are as follows:
 Fee Category School Fee Remittance Deadline Student Data Submission Deadline 
 Without late fee November 17, 2026 November 21, 2026 
 ₹50 late fee December 2, 2026 December 7, 2026 
 ₹200 late fee December 15, 2026 December 17, 2026 
 ₹500 late fee December 29, 2026 December 30, 2026 
 Schools must also submit the School Nominal Roll (NR) to the Director of Government Examinations by December 10 for the first two fee categories and by December 31 for the ₹200 and ₹500 late-fee categories.
